_comment: Wave-0 edit suite. Deterministic lane uses content/oldString/newString/startLine/endLine. Agent lane uses `intent` (the English task given to the model) and `check` (a behavioral assertion body: async fn (m, text) => boolean, where m is the imported edited module and text is the file text). Behavioral checks tolerate formatting differences a real model introduces.

tasks.name: replace-function-body
tasks.intent: In util.ts, improve the slugify function so it trims the input, lowercases it, replaces every run of characters that are NOT lowercase letters or digits with a single hyphen, and removes any leading or trailing hyphen. Do not change the pad function.
tasks.check: return m.slugify('  Hello, World!! ') === 'hello-world' && m.slugify('a__b') === 'a-b' && m.pad(3) === '03';

tasks.name: change-config-value
tasks.intent: In config.ts, change the timeoutMs value from 5000 to 30000. Leave everything else unchanged.

tasks.name: delete-dead-branch
tasks.intent: In handler.ts, delete the entire `if (x < 0)` branch (the legacy negative path) — it is unreachable dead code. Keep the rest of the handle function exactly as is.

tasks.name: rewrite-large-block
tasks.intent: Rewrite the body of parseRange in parse.ts so it parses the trimmed input with a single regex /^(\d+)-(\d+)$/. If it doesn't match, throw an Error whose message starts with 'bad range'. If the start number is greater than the end number, throw an Error whose message starts with 'inverted range'. Otherwise return [start, end] as numbers.
tasks.check: try { const r = m.parseRange('2-5'); if (!(Array.isArray(r) && r[0]===2 && r[1]===5)) return false; } catch { return false; } let bad=false; try { m.parseRange('x'); } catch(e){ bad=/bad range/.test(e.message); } let inv=false; try { m.parseRange('9-2'); } catch(e){ inv=/inverted/.test(e.message); } return bad && inv;
